question: How do strand-bound beings fail to know the Lord?
premises: strand-born states delude the whole world
the Lord is beyond those strands
inference: Strand-bound perception obscures the Lord, while knowing reveals Him.
uncertainties: fused compounds retain unresolved internal sandhi
plain_english: The world is deluded by strand-born states and does not know the supreme imperishable Lord; knowing alone reaches the Lord-principle.
